    const getValue = (selector) => document.querySelector(selector)?.value || \"\";
    const getTextArea = (selector) => document.querySelector(selector)?.value || \"\";
    const getSelectValue = (selector) => document.querySelector(selector)?.value || \"\";
    const getCheckboxState = (selector) => document.querySelector(selector)?.checked || false;
    const isEmpty = (value) => value.trim() === \"\";

    // First Name and Last Name trim logic
    const firstNameEl = document.querySelector(\'input[id=\"ptfname\"]\');
    const lastNameEl = document.querySelector(\'input[id=\"ptlname\"]\');

    let firstName = firstNameEl?.value || \"\";
    let lastName = lastNameEl?.value || \"\";

    if (firstName.trim() !== firstName) {
        firstName = firstName.trim();
        if (firstNameEl) firstNameEl.value = firstName;
    }

    if (lastName.trim() !== lastName) {
        lastName = lastName.trim();
        if (lastNameEl) lastNameEl.value = lastName;
    }

    // Self-pay checkbox state
    const selfPayCheckbox = document.querySelector(\'input[id=\"patient-demographicsIpt15\"]\');
    const isSelfPayChecked = selfPayCheckbox?.checked || false;

    const pcp = getValue(\'input[id=\"ptpcp\"]\');
    const responsibleParty = getTextArea(\'textarea[id=\"textarea1\"]\');
    const defaultFacility = getValue(\'div.input-group.input-group-sm.lookup-drop.dropdown.patient-lookup.specmrleft.padl25.relative.infofacility > input[type=\"text\"]\');

    const data = {
        accountNo: getValue(\'input[id=\"patient-demographicsIpt5\"]\'),
        lastName: lastName,
        firstName: firstName,
        addressLine1: getValue(\'input[id=\"ptaddress\"]\'),
        addressLine2: getValue(\'input[id=\"ptaddress2\"]\'),
        city: getValue(\'input[id=\"ptcity\"]\'),
        state: getValue(\'input[id=\"patient-demographicsIpt8\"]\'),
        county: getValue(\'input[id=\"ptcounty\"]\'),
        zip: getValue(\'input[id=\"ptzip\"]\'),
        country: getValue(\'input[id=\"country\"]\'),
        homePhone: getValue(\'input[id=\"pthomephone\"]\'),
        cellPhone: getValue(\'input[id=\"ptcellphone\"]\'),
        dateOfBirth: getValue(\'input[id=\"dateofbirth\"]\'),
        gender: getSelectValue(\'select[id=\"ptsex\"]\'),
        responsibleParty: responsibleParty,
        IsResponsiblePartyEmpty: isEmpty(responsibleParty),
        insuranceRelation: getValue(\'input[id=\"ptrelation\"]\'),
        pcp: pcp,
        IsPCPEmpty: isEmpty(pcp),
        releaseOfInfo: getValue(\'input[id=\"ptrelinfo\"]\'),
        rxHistoryConsent: getValue(\'input[id=\"ptrxconsent\"]\'),
        defaultFacility: defaultFacility,
        IsDefaultFacilityEmpty: isEmpty(defaultFacility),
        notes: getTextArea(\'textarea[id=\"patientdemographics-AddInformationIpt32\"]\'),
        IsSelfpayChecked: isSelfPayChecked
    };

    return JSON.stringify(data, null, 2); // Pretty print for readability
}
